items.text: Risk reward (maybe decoy) but starting Malik Nabers wherever I have him after active.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere; team wouldn't activate if major concern.
items.why: Expected to play per weekend reports; officially active vs Chargers.
items.implication: Startable RB2 with risk; rookie workload likely.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) is not expected to play and was confirmed inactive vs Lions. Full participant late week but not ready.
items.why: MCL sprain; sources confirm not ready despite full practice.
items.implication: Unchallenged lead role for Etienne; elevated RB2 opportunity.

items.text: Watching late: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), others + Bowers/AJ Brown.
items.implication: Potential mid/late slate impacts; Murray already OUT.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out (wrist) .
items.implication: Increased snaps/targets for other Ravens WRs.

items.implication: Strong start signal despite ankle risk.

items.implication: Extended absence; NE WR corps reshuffle.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active today vs Panthers.
items.why: Expected per sources; limited practice but cleared.
items.implication: Full WR role available in Bears offense.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) OUT for Week 1; realistic chance return Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; short absence expected.
items.implication: Mayer elevated to TE1 short-term; monitor Week 2.
